// @env node
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import process from 'node:process'

async function main() {
  const { argument, defineCommand, run } = await import('@argvia/core')
  const { runMain } = await import('@argvia/node')
  const actions = []
  const command = defineCommand({
    args: [argument.string('action', { required: true })],
    run({ args }) {
      actions.push(args.action)
      return args.action
    },
  })

  await runMain(command)
  assert.deepEqual(actions, ['ready'])
  assert.equal(process.exitCode, 0)
  assert.deepEqual(await run(command, { argv: ['again'] }), { kind: 'executed', value: 'again' })
  assert.deepEqual(actions, ['ready', 'again'])
  await assert.rejects(import('@argvia/node/dist/index.js'), { code: 'ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED' })
  process.stdout.write('跨包消费通过\n')
}

main().catch((error) => {
  console.error(error)
  process.exitCode = 1
})
